memories.title: Us, right now
memories.caption: Replace with a recent photo
memories.story: Three years later: more stories, more tenderness, and so much still to discover.
memories.prompt: What are you proudest of us for this year?

letter: Glyra, three years with you have made ordinary days brighter and difficult days gentler. I love the life we are building in all its small, funny, imperfect details. Thank you for choosing me, challenging me, and making me laugh when I least expect it. I would choose you at the beginning of every story—and I choose you now. Happy anniversary, my love.
